species.name: Striped bass
why: Water 61°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 18–28 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 40 ft, cold below.
South wind at 10 mph pushes bait onto the north shore: try the wind-blown banks.
